args.lesson: The strongest documentation-repair candidate, Layer5 issue 8294, is explicitly assigned to another contributor; its contribution rules require assignment before work. Source availability and a simple fix do not make a task available. Check assignment discussions and contribution prerequisites before fetching implementation files. The remaining search results largely request broader features or documentation, and help-wanted labels provide no evidence of payment.

description: Layer5's repair is explicitly assigned to another contributor and its rules require assignment before work. Reject that candidate; finish the bounded request experiment without inventing paid demand or revenue.
